heroHeadline: Kast Drops His Security Reform as Senators File a 30-Day State-of-Exception Alternative
heroSubtitle: The government withdrew its constitutional security reform on October 6, and on October 7 senators from RN, Republicanos, DC and PPD filed a replacement that caps a state of exception at 30 days with congressional approval for extensions; the executive backs it, but it needs 29 Senate votes. The 2027 budget, submitted September 30, goes to the mixed committee for votes on October 26-28.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chilean government records (Biblioteca del Congreso, Banco Central, SERVEL), Rettig and Valech commissions, IACHR, CIPER Chile, and major international outlets.
